title: APCNV-2024-3631-ZC-HCA
text:
APCNV-2024-3631-ZC-HCA  Council District: 2 – Nazarian
  CEQA: ENV-2024-3633-CE  Last Day to Act: 11-19-26
  Plan Area: Sun Valley – La Tuna Canyon

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  7550, 7550 ½, 7552 and 7554 Bellaire Avenue

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  A Zone Change from RA-1 to (T)R1-1 and a preliminary parcel map to permit the subdivision of one lot
  split into two lots on a gross lot area of 20,998.9 square-foot with a net lot area of 18,900 square feet after
  dedication for the construction of two two-story dwelling units each with a detached one-story Accessory
  Dwelling Unit (which will be reviewed ministerially) on the lot facing Bellaire Avenue and maintain vacant
  on the other lot.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Article 19, Sections 15303 (Class
  3) and 15315 (Class 15), an Exemption from CEQA and that there is no substantial evidence
  demonstrating that an exception to a categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section
  15300.2 applies.
  2. Pursuant to Section 12.32 F of the Los Angeles Municipal Code, a Zone Change from RA-1 to (T)R1-
  1 to permit the subdivision of one lot split into two lots with a gross lot area of 20,998.9 square-foot
  with a net lot area of 18,900 square feet after dedication for the construction of two two-story dwelling
  units each with a detached one-story Accessory Dwelling Unit (which will be reviewed ministerially).

  Applicant:  Zhirayr Vandanyan and Artur Martirosyan
  Representative: Suzzi Grigoryan, Lampert Group

  Staff:  Joanna Marroquin, Planning Assistant
  joanna.marroquin@lacity.org
  (213) 978-1463
summary: The North Valley Area Planning Commission will consider rezoning 7550–7554 Bellaire Avenue in Sun Valley from RA-1 to (T)R1-1 and splitting the property into two lots. The plan allows two homes with detached accessory dwelling units on the Bellaire Avenue lot, and the other lot would stay vacant.

details.action: Zone change and parcel map to split one lot into two
